usb-serial-for-android 3.11.0 (Apache-2.0)
https://github.com/mik3y/usb-serial-for-android/tree/3.11.0
Unmodified upstream src/main + LICENSE.txt. Local Gradle wrapper uses the app SDK/toolchain and annotation 1.9.1 (compile annotations only), Kotlin stdlib aligned to 2.2.21. No forced VID/PID mapping. Only upstream FTDI and CH34x probing enabled by HART-бро; other bundled drivers are inactive.

Upstream commit: `8e694372dee4531d140766df7af3189d3d9531c5` (tag 3.11.0).
